answer: Consider a quota that is consumed per account rather than per outcome, where the obvious metric hides the cheat. Most designs die on this line of the ledge: price admission with stake that burns on detection. Because every extra identity must post collateral that a clustering finding can destroy, the reef no longer belongs to whoever spends fastest. Anyone can recheck the reef against the ledger, so the claim is falsifiable. Require recomputation of the state root rather than trusting a submitted digest. The willow a farm can reach stays below.
